name: datocms
description: DatoCMS skills for content delivery, content management, content modeling, Structured Text, CLI workflows, frontend integrations, plugin development, and project setup

interface.shortDescription: Content delivery, management, modeling, Structured Text, CLI, frontends, plugin dev, and project setup for DatoCMS
interface.longDescription: Focused DatoCMS skills: query content (CDA/GraphQL), manage records and schema (CMA), make content-modeling decisions (models vs blocks, taxonomies, reuse, limits, admin UI), work with Structured Text (DAST) documents, run CLI workflows and migrations, integrate with frontend frameworks (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit), build, maintain, and restyle DatoCMS plugins, and guide project setup (previews and visual editing, caching, SEO, migrations, imports) with a plan you confirm before anything changes.
defaultPrompt: Write a GraphQL query for my DatoCMS blog posts
Add DatoCMS draft mode and previews to this app
Write a migration that adds an SEO field to a model
